<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Today, May 7, 2026, the Registrant is issuing a press release (furnished
as Exhibit&#160;99.1 to this report) announcing its fiscal 2026 second quarter financial and operating results. The press release will
be posted on the Registrant&#8217;s investor website (<span style="text-decoration: underline">https://investor.escotechnologies.com</span>), although the Registrant reserves
the right to discontinue that availability at any time.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Registrant will conduct a related webcast conference call today
at 4:00 p.m.&#160;Central Time. The conference call webcast will be available on the Registrant&#8217;s investor website (<span style="text-decoration: underline">https://investor.escotechnologies.com</span>).
A slide presentation will be utilized during the call and will be posted on the website prior to the call. For those unable to participate,
a webcast replay will be available after the call on the website<span style="text-decoration: underline">,</span> although the Registrant reserves the right to discontinue that
availability at any time.</p>
